name: Shenxue
body:
The shenxue are mortals touched by the primal bloodlines of the celestial dragons. Manifesting shimmering scales, radiant eyes, and subtle elemental auras, they are revered and feared as scions of the heavens.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Racial Traits: Shenxue possess magnetic personalities and sharp intellects, but their physical forms are delicate. They gain +2 Intelligence, +2 Charisma, and -2 Strength.
Type: Humanoid (dragon). Shenxue are humanoids with the dragon subtype.
Size: Medium. Shenxue have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Normal. Shenxue have a base land speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Shenxue begin play speaking Common and Draconic. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Celestial, Ignan, Aquan, Auran, and Terran.
Senses and Defense Racial Traits
Darkvision: Shenxue can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
Low-Light Vision: Shenxue can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Draconic Scale: Fine scales provide a +1 natural armor bonus to AC.
Elemental Affinity: Each shenxue chooses an elemental dragon affinity at 1st level (acid, cold, electricity, or fire). The shenxue gains energy resistance 5 against the chosen energy type. Once chosen, this selection cannot be changed.
Magical Racial Traits
Breath of the Heaven-Born (Su): Once per day as a standard action, a shenxue can exhale a 15-foot cone of elemental energy matching their elemental affinity. This breath weapon deals 1d6 points of energy damage (Reflex save DC 10 + 1/2 character level + Constitution modifier for half). The damage increases by 1d6 for every 4 character levels beyond 1st (to a maximum of 5d6 at 17th level).
Skill Racial Traits
Heavenly Grace: Shenxue receive a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks.
